hero.title: Legal help, *close to home*
hero.lede: Real estate, family law, civil litigation, business law, and estates, wills and trusts, mostly in Aiken and Edgefield counties and throughout South Carolina.

sections.title: Aiken and Edgefield, *and statewide*
body: The Zier Law Firm handles its matters mostly in Aiken and Edgefield counties, but also throughout the entire state of South Carolina.
Our office is on West Avenue in North Augusta.

sections.title: Talk it through with us
sections.text: Call the office on West Avenue to set up a time.

visit.title: Visit us on *West Avenue*
visit.intro: A message here reaches the office; please do not include confidential details.
